sovereign_country.strategic_role: 西欧核心消费市场、高客单价品牌合规与本土清关

business_scope.primary_industry_name: Publishing of Massively Multiplayer Online Role-Playing Games

meta_jurisdiction_context.legal_system_doctrine: Civil Law (with mandatory commercial and administrative codes, and European Union law supremacy)
applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: France–China Investment Protection Agreement (1984, as amended by the 2007 Exchange of Letters)
France–United States Double Taxation Convention (1994, as amended)

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Articles L.561-1 to L.561-57 of the French Monetary and Financial Code (Code monétaire et financier); Law No. 2016-1691 of 9 December 2016 (Sapin II); Decree No. 2018-284 of 18 April 2018; Articles R.561-1 et seq. of the French Monetary and Financial Code; French Commercial Code Article L.123-18 (UBO declaration filed with the RCS); EU Directive (EU) 2015/849 (AMLD5) as transposed.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Passport or national identity card of each shareholder and manager (gérant) of the SARL
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: National passport issuing authority of the relevant country
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille for notarized copies; consular legalization for non-Hague countries

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of incorporation and good standing of any corporate shareholder/UBO entity
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Competent companies registry of the entity's jurisdiction of incorporation
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille or consular legalization followed by certified French translation

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of share capital deposit (attestation de dépôt des fonds) issued by a French bank or notary
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: French bank deposit institution or notary (notaire)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Notarization; domestic instrument, apostille normally not required

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Legal announcement publication receipt (attestation de parution)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Approved legal announcements journal (journal d'annonces légales)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Original receipt; domestic document, no apostille required

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory screening of all shareholders, directors and beneficial owners against the OFAC SDN List, United Nations Security Council Consolidated List, EU Consolidated Financial Sanctions List, French Asset Freeze List (Direction générale du Trésor), and the French BODACC official journal. The incorporation agent must apply risk-based enhanced due diligence for politically exposed persons (PEPs) and independently verify source of wealth and funds to the standard of Article L.561-10 of the French Monetary and Financial Code.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: INPI – Registre National du Commerce et des Sociétés (RNCS), accessible via https://procedures.inpi.fr; legacy Infogreffe portal also displays RCS name status.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: The corporate name (dénomination sociale) may be in any language but must be written in Latin alphabet characters; if words from a non-Latin script are used, they must be transliterated into Latin characters. The name must include or be followed by the legal form 'SARL' and must comply with Article R.123-58 of the French Commercial Code, not being contrary to public order, not misleading the public, and not reproducing an earlier corporate name or trademark already protected in France.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: If the requested name is refused, the applicant must first resubmit the incorporation dossier with a revised name or address the specific refusal grounds to the greffe (commercial court registry) in writing. If the refusal is maintained, the applicant may petition the President of the Commercial Court (Tribunal de commerce) in summary proceedings (référé) to overturn the refusal. A further administrative appeal may be lodged with the INPI within 4 months of notification of refusal, pursuant to Articles R.411-19 et seq. of the French Intellectual Property Code.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: A virtual office is permissible for an SARL engaged in ISIC 5820 software/game publishing, provided the registered address is a duly licensed commercial domiciliation entity approved by the préfecture, or a qualified domiciliation company under Law No. 94-126 of 11 February 1994. At least one local point must accept service of process, and the company must be able to produce full accounting records at the registered office if required.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: 20-25% likelihood in the first fiscal year; unannounced inspections may be performed by the French tax administration (DGFiP), social security authorities (URSSAF), and the Directorate General for Competition, Consumer Affairs and Fraud Control (DGCCRF); the risk increases if the registered office is solely a mail-forwarding facility.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Name availability search and pre-clearance certificate application
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Official statutary fee for RNCS name reservation plus prevailing market rate for professional search

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Publication of legal notice in an approved legal announcements journal (journal d'annonces légales)
Filing of incorporation dossier with RCS via INPI/Guichet unique (P0 form, articles of association, UBO declaration)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Official statutory registry fee (frais de greffe) for SARL incorporation

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Notarial deed (required only where real estate or certain in-kind contributions are made)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Scale of notarial fees fixed by the decree of 8 March 1978

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Legal drafting of the SARL statutes (articles of association) by French counsel
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market benchmark for standard SARL incorporation

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Apostille / legalization / certified translation bundle for foreign shareholders and UBOs
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Ministry of Foreign Affairs Apostille Service / French consulate / sworn translator
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory fee per document plus certified translation market rates

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Registered office domiciliation service, first year
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Market benchmark, statutory cap under Law No. 94-126 of 11 February 1994

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Bank or statutory auditor handling of share capital deposit and any in-kind contribution report
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Market benchmark where capital threshold is exceeded or non-cash assets are contributed

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: French Commercial Code (Code de commerce), Book II, Title III — Articles L. 223-1 to L. 223-43 on the Societe a Responsabilite Limitee (SARL); implementing decree Articles R. 223-1 et seq.; formation and registration formalities under Articles L. 123-1, L. 123-5 and R. 123-304 et seq.; beneficial ownership declaration under Article L. 561-46 of the Monetary and Financial Code; Loi PACTE n° 2019-486 and Decret n° 2021-300 establishing the Guichet unique.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Registre du commerce et des societes (RCS) administered by the Greffe du Tribunal de commerce of the registered office (Paris); all formation filings are submitted exclusively through the INPI-operated Guichet unique electronique at formalites.entreprises.gouv.fr.
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Statuts constitutifs (Articles of Association) executed either as a private deed (acte sous seing prive) or as a notarial deed, accompanied by the single incorporation declaration transmitted via the Guichet unique.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum capital applies (Article L. 223-2 alinea 2 of the Commercial Code); the articles must freely fix the capital amount. If the fixed capital is below EUR 10,000, cash contributions must be fully paid up at incorporation; if capital is EUR 10,000 or more, at least one-fifth of each cash contribution must be liberated at subscription and the balance within five years (Article L. 223-7). The subscribed funds must be deposited into a blocked escrow account with a credit institution or the Caisse des Depots et Consignations and evidenced by a blocking certificate; the funds may be released only upon presentation of the K-bis registration certificate.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED: (1) The Articles of Association of the SARL are approved and the company is constituted with effect from registration at the Registre du Commerce et des Societes of Paris. (2) The cash subscriptions to the share capital are ratified in accordance with the capital schedule annexed. (3) The registered office is fixed at 24 Rue de la Paix, 75002 Paris, France. (4) Mr./Ms. [Name] is appointed Gerant with full powers to bind the company within the corporate object. (5) The corporate bank account at [Bank] and its signatories are approved. (6) The Gerant is authorised to publish the statutory legal notice, file the incorporation dossier on the Guichet unique, and perform all ancillary formalities.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Drafting and execution of the Articles of Association with preliminary name verification
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Infogreffe national RCS directory and INPI trademark database for the name availability search; execution before a notaire (optional) or as a private deed signed by all shareholders.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Conduct the corporate name search in the Infogreffe and INPI databases to verify the absence of identical or confusingly similar RCS names and trademarks; verify domain name availability. Determine the corporate object restricted to software publishing and MMORPG operations, the share capital schedule, the registered office address, the duration (99 years by default), and the powers of the Gerant. Execute the statuts either as an acte sous seing prive or as a notarial deed where an in-kind contribution of immovable property or a business fund is made. Ensure the articles include all mandatory clauses under Articles L. 223-1 et seq., including the report on in-kind contributions if applicable.
required_dossiers: Extract of the RCS and INPI search report evidencing name availability
Identity documents (national ID or passport) of all shareholders and the designated Gerant
Draft statuts constitutifs (private deed or notarial deed)
Beneficial owner questionnaire (bénéficiaires effectifs) under Article L. 561-46 of the Monetary and Financial Code
Declaration on honour of non-conviction of the Gerant (Article L. 223-5 of the Commercial Code)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name is refused or challenged by a prior trademark or company-name holder, remodulate the corporate name by adding a distinctive element and re-execute the articles. Any substantive inconsistency in the deed is cured by a supplementary unanimous shareholder decision (acte rectificatif) adopted before the incorporation filing.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Blocking of the subscribed share capital and issuance of the bank blocking certificate
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: A commercial credit institution authorised in France or the Caisse des Depots et Consignations (CDC), acting as escrow depositary.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Open a provisional account in the name of the future company; transfer the subscribed cash contributions to the blocked account; instruct the bank to issue the mandatory attestation de blocage des fonds (blocking certificate) stating the deposited amount and the blocked status. The funds remain irrevocably reserved for the benefit of the future company until release against presentation of the K-bis registration certificate.
required_dossiers: Project of the statuts incorporating the capital subscription schedule
Identity documents of the cash contributors (KYC requirement of the bank)
Beneficial ownership information for the bank's KYC file
Provisional account opening forms signed by the future Gerant
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the bank refuses or delays the issuance of the certificate, obtain a written refusal and approach the Caisse des Depots et Consignations as a substitute depositary. Where the certificate is formally irregular, require the institution to reissue a compliant attestation; in case of a notarial deed, the notaire may alternatively hold the funds and deliver the blocking certificate.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Publication of the statutory legal notice of incorporation in an approved legal gazette
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Journal d'annonces legales (JAL) authorised by prefectural decree for the department of the registered office, e.g. the authorised legal gazette for Paris.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Draft the avis de constitution containing the legal form (SARL), corporate name, registered office, corporate object, share capital, duration, identity of the Gerant, and the RCS office of registration. Submit the notice to the chosen JAL and pay the publication fees. Collect the attestation de parution (certificate of publication) issued by the gazette and retain it for the incorporation filing with the Guichet unique.
required_dossiers: Text of the avis de constitution prepared in accordance with Article R. 123-153 of the Commercial Code
Copy of the statuts for the gazette's verification
Attestation de parution issued by the JAL after the notice is printed
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the published notice contains an error or omission, publish a rectificatif in the same gazette and obtain an amended certificate. If the gazette chosen is not authorised for the registered-office department, publish a new notice in an approved gazette and discard the invalid publication.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Filing of the incorporation dossier with the Guichet unique and registration at the RCS
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Guichet unique electronique operated by INPI, transmitting the file to the Greffe du Tribunal de commerce of Paris (RCS Paris).
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Create the declarant account on the INPI portal; select the SARL incorporation form; complete the automated declaration (Cerfa-type form) with the corporate data; upload all statutory documents; pay the greffe tariff electronically; submit the file and monitor the portal notifications. Upon validation, the guichet issues the acknowledgement of filing; the greffe completes the registration and the INSEE system generates the SIREN and SIRET numbers.
required_dossiers: Signed statuts constitutifs (scanned copy)
Attestation de blocage des fonds (capital blocking certificate)
Attestation de parution issued by the legal gazette
Declaration on honour of non-conviction of the Gerant
Copies of identity documents of the Gerant and all shareholders
Declaration of beneficial owners (form with personal data of actual beneficiaries)
Certificate of domiciliation of the registered office (lease agreement or attestation of the property owner)
Power of attorney if the filing is made through a representative
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the guichet or the greffe issues a query for an incomplete dossier, regularise the file within the notified delay (ordinarily 15 days) or the application is rejected; if the Public Prosecutor opposes the registration for incapacity or an irregular corporate object, submit written observations to the greffe, amend the articles by supplementary resolution and re-file; a final refusal may be challenged before the President of the competent court in summary proceedings.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Post-registration formalities, release of capital, and ancillary public registrations
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Greffe du Tribunal de commerce (K-bis issuance), INSEE (SIREN/SIRET/APE code), URSSAF (social security employer registration), CNIL (data protection officer designation), Direction generale des finances publiques (tax registrations), and the regional occupational health service.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Upon receipt of the K-bis extract, produce the certified copy to the bank to release the blocked capital. Register the company as an employer with URSSAF and file the pre-hiring declaration for the first employee. Verify the INSEE APE code (5820C for software publishing). Notify the CNIL of the appointment of a data protection officer and establish the processing register. Submit the game content rating questionnaire to PEGI S.A. before the first storefront distribution of the MMORPG. Update the beneficial ownership file if any change occurs and complete any professional insurance and payroll-related formalities.
required_dossiers: Extrait K-bis (registration certificate)
Letter to the bank requesting release of the escrowed capital with the K-bis attached
URSSAF employer registration form and DPAE (pre-hiring declaration) for the first employee
CNIL DPO designation form
PEGI age-rating and content-descriptor questionnaire for the MMORPG
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If URSSAF or CNIL returns queries, answer within the procedural deadlines; late DPO designation is regularised ex officio without penalty where no data breach has occurred. If the bank refuses to release the escrow, cure the default by serving a formal notice with the certified K-bis or, failing that, obtain a court order for release. If the PEGI submission is incomplete, resubmit the corrected questionnaire before retail listing.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Ministere de la Culture — Direction generale des medias et des industries culturelles (DGMIC) and the Centre national du cinema et de l'image animee (CNC) for video-game registration and age-rating policy; ARCOM for digital platform moderation obligations; online filing portals: formalites.entreprises.gouv.fr (INPI) and PEGI S.A. via the ISFE.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: No sectoral operating permit is imposed on software or video-game publishers under French law (the activity is not listed among the regulated professions). Mandatory ancillary certifications and registrations conditioning lawful exploitation: (i) PEGI Pan European Game Information Age Rating Certificate for retail and digital-storefront distribution in France and the EU; (ii) optional CNC registration of the video game for the video-game tax credit; (iii) CNIL data protection officer designation and processing register under the GDPR and the French Data Protection Act; (iv) ARCOM and Digital Services Act platform reporting and content-moderation duties applicable to the MMORPG's online communication features; (v) URSSAF employer registration prior to hiring staff in France.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Ministere de la Transition ecologique et de la Cohesion des territoires — Direction generale de la prevention des risques (DGPR), with consultation of the local DREAL only in case of significant premises fitting-out works.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Exempt — office-based software-publishing activity is not itemised in the annexe to Article R. 122-2 of the Environmental Code and is not subject to the ICPE (installations classees) nomenclature under Article L. 511-1; no formal environmental impact assessment or environmental authorisation is required at incorporation.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Non-manufacturing activity: no industrial wastewater, VOC, or atmospheric emission thresholds apply. The premises must comply with municipal sanitation standards for office buildings and the workplace air-quality and ventilation rules under Articles R. 4222-1 et seq. of the Labour Code. Waste electrical and electronic equipment reporting obligations apply under insertion of Article L. 541-10 of the Environmental Code where any IT hardware is placed on the market; energy-efficiency reporting thresholds of the REEN law (Loi n° 2021-1485) apply to digital platforms once traffic thresholds are reached.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire-safety certification under the ERP regime (Type W workplaces): premises accommodating 301 or more persons or exceeding 7,000 m² require a commission de securite approval; below those thresholds, a technical fire-safety inspection by an approved bureau de controle is recommended. Electrical installations in new or renovated offices require the CONSUEL conformity attestation. Structural load clearance by a technical controller is required where office floor loads exceed 250 kg/m². Occupational clearance: registration with the regional occupational health service (SST), establishment of the Document unique d'evaluation des risques professionnels (DUERP) under Articles R. 4121-1 et seq., and completion of information and prevention visits for each employee, including ergonomic assessment of video-display-unit workstations under Articles R. 4541-1 et seq. of the Labour Code.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Direction Générale des Finances Publiques (DGFiP) — Service des Impôts des Entreprises (SIE); digital portal: impots.gouv.fr (professional/enterprise area); corporate registry interface: formalites.entreprises.gouv.fr (Guichet Unique, operated with INPI).
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: A French SARL is registered at formation via the Guichet Unique de l'INPI, which issues the SIREN (9-digit) and SIRET (14-digit) numbers; the DGFiP assigns the VAT identification number (numéro de TVA intracommunautaire) ex officio in the format 'FR' + 2-key + SIREN without dots. Foreign entities not established in France apply for a French VAT number directly to the SIE using Cerfa form no. 15495*03 (and no. 15767*01 where relevant), submitting proof of foreign incorporation, statutory documents, evidence of the first taxable transaction, and — for third-country suppliers — a local tax representative appointment. The VAT number must appear on all B2B invoices and intra-community recapitulative statements.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: A SARL is by default subject to corporate income tax (impôt sur les sociétés, IS) at the entity level: 25% standard rate, with a 15% reduced rate on the first EUR 42,500 of annual taxable profit for qualifying SMEs. Small or family-controlled SARLs may elect, under CGI Article 239 bis AA, to be taxed transparently at the member level (impôt sur le revenu), subject to eligibility conditions and the consequences of the option. France transposes ATAD/ATAD 2 hybrid-mismatch rules: foreign entity classification (opaque vs transparent) is assessed under Article 238 bis CGI (qualified 'check-the-box'-type analysis), with corresponding anti-hybrid disallowances; there is no literal US-style check-the-box election, but the CGI options function as statutory classification elections.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms_note: For cross-border structure with Apple/Google payouts: the SARL will be treated as fiscally opaque and a French tax resident; any CFC/hybrid element from non-French pay-through entities is scrutinized under Article 209 B and ATAD rules; no separate registration for tax consolidation (intégration fiscale) applies unless the SARL is a wholly-owned subsidiary of a French parent group (optional election under Article 223 A CGI).

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: VAT (Taxe sur la Valeur Ajoutée / TVA)
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: No registration threshold for a French-established SARL: VAT registration is compulsory for the video game publishing/digital software activity (ISIC 5820) irrespective of turnover; the franchise de TVA thresholds (EUR 91,900 for goods and EUR 36,800 for services for 2025) do not apply to digital publishing or electronically supplied services to EU consumers. For intra-community distance sales of digital services to consumers, the annual EUR 10,000 OSS threshold applies: once exceeded, VAT must be declared in each EU member state of the consumer through the OSS (Non-Union or Union procedure).
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Mandatory B2B e-invoicing is phased in under the 2026–2027 French tax reform: from 1 September 2026, all French taxable persons must issue structured e-invoices through certified partner dematerialization platforms (PDPs) interconnected with the DGFiP (Chorus Pro/PPF); B2C and cross-border transaction data must be transmitted via periodic e-reporting. The DGFiP does not perform real-time fiscal stamping of invoices, but complete invoice records must be retained for six (6) years and produced electronically during tax audits (CGI Article L 102 B). Every intra-EU B2B invoice must include the French and recipient VAT numbers; OSS quarterly returns and payment are filed directly on the DGFiP OSS portal.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.notes_on_platform_payment_rails: For App Store/Google Play payouts, the platform (Apple/Google) generally acts as the deemed supplier for B2C supplies of digital services under the deemed-supplier rules; the SARL must nonetheless retain platform payout reports, VAT treatment documentation, and reconcile net settlements against French VAT returns and, where applicable, OSS filings.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Zero-rating (exonération with credit) applies under CGI Article 262-I-1° for tangible goods physically exported outside the EU. For intangible/digital services — including MMORPG licensing, online access, in-app virtual goods, hosting, and downloadable content — 0% VAT applies when the place of supply is outside France: B2B services to a recipient established outside the EU (Article 259-1 CGI), B2C digital services to consumers outside the EU (Article 259 D CGI), and intra-EU B2B supplies to a VAT-registered customer with a valid EU VAT number (Article 262 ter CGI). The supplier must evidence the customer's non-French establishment, the commercial substance of the export, and the arm's-length nature of platform payouts; pure domestic French B2C digital sales attract 20% VAT, and intra-EU B2C digital sales attract the customer's member-state rate via OSS.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs export declaration (DAU) and exit summary declaration (ICS2 / e-FR) for any physical media or hardware
Export invoice identifying the buyer, the nature of the digital goods/services (MMORPG licence, virtual items, server access), and a clear 0% TVA mention with legal basis
Contractual documentation: online terms of service, software license agreement, order confirmations, and app-store payout reports (Apple App Store Connect / Google Play Console)

Proof of non-French establishment of the customer: valid EU VAT number for intra-EU B2B supplies, or government-issued address/identity evidence, IP-address/location logs for B2C consumers outside the EU

Payment / foreign-exchange evidence: SWIFT confirmations, PSP settlement statements (Apple/Google payouts, Stripe, Braintree), banker's attestation de change / inward remittance certificates, evidencing repatriation of proceeds within the statutory deadline
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: Export zero-rating claims are subject to strict DGFiP tax audit (vérification de comptabilité) and DGDDI customs scrutiny. Unsubstantiated or fraudulent zero-rating triggers: retroactive reversal of the exemption and output VAT recovery at 20%; late-payment interest (intérêts de retard, approximately 0.20% per month); and penalties under CGI Article 1729 — 40% for deliberate bad-faith omissions (manquement délibéré), 80% for fraudulent activity (manœuvres frauduleuses / abus de droit), and up to 100% for organized tax fraud. Criminal sanctions under CGI Article 1741 (tax evasion / escroquerie fiscale) include up to five (5) years' imprisonment and a EUR 500,000 fine (EUR 1,000,000 for organized fraud). Clawback and reassessment periods extend to six (6) years generally, and up to ten (10) years for concealed activity; input VAT wrongly deducted on export supplies is disgorged with interest, and repeated offenders may face suspension of customs/export authorizations and debarment from the OSS.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Banque de France (Bank of France), acting in coordination with the European Central Bank (ECB), the French Treasury (Direction Générale du Trésor) for foreign-investment screening and trade statistics, and the Autorité de Contrôle Prudentiel et de Résolution (ACPR) as the competent prudential and AML/CFT supervisor for French credit institutions and payment institutions.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Full euro convertibility for both capital and current account transactions; France has maintained unrestricted capital movement since the 1988 liberalisation and transposes Articles 63 to 66 of the Treaty on the Functioning of the European Union. There are no central-bank exchange controls, no prior approvals for current-account remittances, and no restrictions on profit remittance, dividend distribution, royalty outflow, or intercompany repayment by a French SARL to non-resident shareholders. Remittance constraints are limited to: (i) EU/UN/OFAC financial-sanctions screening under Article L.561-1 of the Code monétaire et financier; (ii) the administrative prior-authorisation regime for foreign investments in sensitive sectors under the 2019 Pacte Law, which does not apply to digital MMORPG publishing (ISIC 5820); and (iii) French withholding tax of 25% on dividend distributions to non-EU parent corporations, reducible to 0-15% under applicable double-tax treaties or the EU Parent-Subsidiary Directive where the parent holds at least 5% (10% under the Directive) of the SARL capital for 24 months.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: France imposes no statutory export-proceeds surrender period and no mandatory conversion ratio on any export receipts. The SARL may lawfully retain revenues from Apple Distribution International Ltd and Google Commerce Ltd (both Irish-resident settlement entities) in EUR or any foreign currency, in France or abroad. The only binding reporting obligations are: (i) French credit institutions must include cross-border settlements exceeding EUR 300,000 per calendar month per counterpart in the Banque de France balance-of-payments statistical return; (ii) the SARL must file the annual Déclaration d'Échanges de Services (DES/SDES) for cross-border service exports and imports where the annual threshold is exceeded, which will be the case given global MMORPG license, marketing, and server-hosting flows; and (iii) transfers exceeding EUR 10,000 must be supported by documented underlying commercial or financing evidence at the request of the bank under France's AML/CTF framework. No export documentation (e.g., a certificate of repatriation or exchange-control form) is required for digital service exports.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Capital Escrow Account (compte de dépôt de fonds for SARL formation) plus operational current account (compte courant professionnel) with FX hedging and trade-finance module
Operational current account (compte courant) with multi-currency capability, SWIFT MT103 execution, and ISDA/AMF FX hedging framework
Operational current account (compte d'exploitation) with online banking and SEPA clearing; capital deposit possible at local caisses

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.bank_name: BPCE (Banque Populaire and Caisse d'Épargne network)
tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Operational corporate account (compte bancaire professionnel) with regional advisory and basic FX products
Operational current account (compte professionnel) with mobile banking and SEPA direct debit facilities
Basic operational account only; no integrated FX hedging or international trade-desk capability

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Feasibility rating: High for French-authorised EMIs (Qonto, Shine, Manager.one, Blank) and EU-passported EMIs (Revolut, Wise Europe, N26) that operate under PSD2 licences, provided the SARL maintains a parallel anchor operating account with a French tier-1 bank for trade finance and treasury credit lines. Medium for a standalone EMI-only structure, as ACPR supervisory practice and French corporate creditors expect a substantive banking history. Legal constraints: (i) non-EU offshore digital EMIs without a French or EU PSD2 licence cannot lawfully hold operating funds for a French SARL; (ii) UK-headquartered EMIs lost EU passporting after Brexit and must operate through EU-licensed partner entities; (iii) SEPA anti-IBAN-discrimination provisions in Regulation (EU) No 260/2012 entitle the SARL to reject refusal of instant SEPA credit transfers solely because the IBAN is not French; and (iv) Apple and Google payout settlement requires a fully compliant SEPA IBAN and clean inbound credit history, which French EMIs provide.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Traditional tier-1 credit institutions (BNP Paribas, Société Générale, Crédit Agricole) universally require a physical in-branch interview with the gérant (manager) and with any ultimate beneficial owner holding more than 25% of the SARL share capital for preliminary onboarding and transaction-limit activation. Remote onboarding is available only through regulated French neobanks and EMIs using ACPR-compliant video-KYC and biometric identity verification; it is not available for trade credit lines, FX hedging, or foreign-currency accounts at legacy banks. A French registered office is non-waivable: the SARL must evidence either a six-month lease or a valid contrat de domiciliation (registered-office service agreement) with a professional domiciliation provider bearing a SIREN. The extrait Kbis (RCS extract) dated within three months, the Registre des Bénéficiaires Effectifs (RBE) filing, and the SIRET number are mandatory documents for all account openings.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Non-French-resident gérant or beneficial owners, particularly non-EU nationals, creating an inbound remote-management red flag.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Valid government-issued passport and proof of foreign residence; French tax residency annexe; signed gérant mandate and statuts (by-laws) with notarised signatures where required; RBE beneficial-ownership register; six-month French office lease or domiciliation contract; CV and professional references; ACPR-standard source-of-wealth questionnaire covering the Apple/Google distribution revenue model; SIREN/SIRET registration extract; and a 12-month business plan and treasury forecast.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: High-velocity micro-transaction virtual-currency revenue (in-app purchases) settled by Apple and Google, which can resemble per-customer aggregation, refund abuse, or undeclared digital-asset activity in bank typologies.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Executed Apple Developer Program License Agreement and Google Play Developer Distribution Agreement; official payout statements from each platform (iTunes Connect and Play Console settlement reports) showing negative chargeback thresholds and refund rates; the SARL's written refund and virtual-currency redemption policy; server-side transaction logs or anonymised statistical volume reports proving genuine gameplay value; user-terms agreement; and a legal opinion or internal AML note confirming that game-specific virtual items are not regulated as financial instruments under French AMF rules.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Pass-through fund structure: inbound settlement from Irish platform entities without direct invoicing to end consumers, which banks may treat as undisclosed agency or conduit activity.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: B2B invoices issued by the SARL to Apple Distribution International Ltd and Google Commerce Ltd under the applicable commission or distribution model; SWIFT MT103 or SEPA statement showing the exact settlement reference; the underlying developer program agreements; a transfer-pricing documentation file compliant with Article L.13 AA and 57 of the French Tax Procedure Code; VAT position demonstrating French and EU reverse-charge treatment of digital services; and the SARL's audited or accountant-prepared annual accounts evidencing booked revenue.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Registered office at a commercial domiciliation address rather than a physical operating office, a classic shell-company indicator under bank CDD policies.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Signed contrat de domiciliation issued by a regulated provider (e.g., Regus, Multicorporis) with the provider's SIREN; Kbis extract dated within the last three months; shareholders' register and RBE declaration; evidence of the gérant's actual management activity (e.g., business correspondence, client contracts, bank invoices); website platform presence; and a management interview demonstrating intimate knowledge of the SARL's MMORPG operations.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Customer or outsourcing counter-party exposure to high-risk jurisdictions (gift-card resellers, gold-farming operators, sanctioned-territory players) contaminating the SARL's transaction flow.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: IP-geolocation and platform-restriction evidence from Apple App Store Connect and Google Play Console demonstrating geo-blocking of OFAC/EU-sanctioned territories; a board-approved AML/CFT internal control manual and transaction-monitoring procedure; due-diligence files on material B2B contractors (payment aggregators, influencer agencies, server hosts); no-cash and no-P2P policy; quarterly sanctions-screening logs; and if thresholds are triggered, the statutory appointment of a commissaire aux comptes (statutory auditor) to certify the internal-control environment.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Initial share capital of the SARL is deposited via a domestic virement into a blocked formation account (compte de dépôt de fonds) at the onboarding bank; upon RCS registration and issuance of the extrait Kbis, the blocked account is automatically released to the operating current account. For inbound capital contributions from a non-resident sole shareholder, the compliant protocol is a SWIFT MT103 or SEPA credit transfer to the SARL's IBAN with ISO External Purpose Code INVS (Investment), free-text 'Apport en capital - constitution SARL', and supporting documentation including the signed statuts, the shareholders' capital-subscription resolution, the RBE extract, and a completed bank source-of-funds questionnaire. No prior French Treasury authorisation is required because digital game publishing is not a sensitive sector under Article L.151-3 of the Code monétaire et financier; however, the receiving bank must report cross-border financial flows in its monthly Banque de France balance-of-payments return when thresholds are met, and any single credit over EUR 10,000 must be fully evidenced under Article L.561-15 CMF.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Outbound treasury clearing uses the following rails: (i) SEPA Credit Transfer / SEPA Instant (XML pacs.008) for all euro-denominated EU supplier payments, salaries, and French social contributions; (ii) SWIFT MT103 with correspondent-bank routing for non-euro and non-SEPA disbursements, including server-hosting costs, overseas influencer agency fees, and non-EU development contractors, using standard ISO purpose codes such as INTC (intercompany payment), ROYL (royalty/licence payment), or TRAD (trade settlement) as applicable; (iii) Commercial Letters of Credit under UCP600 are permissible but not operationally necessary for a purely digital MMORPG model with no physical merchandise; should the SARL later import branded merchandise, an irrevocable sight LC or documentary collection would be added; and (iv) platform revenue is collected as SEPA inbound credits from Apple Distribution International Ltd and Google Commerce Ltd, which must be reconciled daily against payout statements to maintain clean treasury provenance for VAT, corporate income tax, and transfer-pricing audits.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Deliverable FX forwards (change à terme) with ACPR-authorised French credit institutions under an AMF/ISDA master agreement, documented as a hedge of committed USD contractor payables with no speculative leverage
FX swaps (swap de change) for temporary management of EUR/USD liquidity mismatches between the euro payout cycle and USD-denominated operating expenses
Plain-vanilla FX options and collar/tunnel structures purchased strictly to cap adverse rate movement on forecast dividend or intercompany royalty repatriation, with premium paid upfront

Non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) in non-deliverable currencies (e.g., Chinese yuan, Indian rupee, Korean won) where the SARL books direct developer, advertising, or platform-liability payables in those currencies and has no local branch, executed with a French bank under a confirmable NDF master and recorded under IFRS 9 hedge accounting

Cross-currency swaps (cross-currency interest rate swaps) used only where a long-term USD intercompany loan exceeding EUR 5,000,000 is entered into; all derivative transactions require EMIR reporting, ISDA CSA collateral documentation, and internal treasury-policy approval

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Ordinary general meeting of shareholders approving annual accounts (assemblee generale ordinaire)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Corporate minutes book and shareholders' decisions register held at the registered office; no separate governmental filing, but approval is a precondition for the deposit of accounts
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within six months of the close of the financial year; extension is possible only by court order upon the manager's request
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Any interested person or the Public Prosecutor may petition the Commercial Court to compel the meeting; persistent failure exposes managers to civil liability and to the penalties applicable to non-deposit of annual accounts

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Deposit of annual accounts package (balance sheet, income statement, notes, management report) with the Trade and Companies Register (depot des comptes annuels)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Registry of the Commercial Court (Greffe du Tribunal de Commerce) through the Guichet Unique des Formalites des Entreprises and the RCS file
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within six months of the financial year close and, in any event, within fifteen days after shareholder approval of the accounts; electronic filing is mandatory
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Registry issues a formal notice and, in case of default, obtains a court injunction with periodic penalty payments (astreinte); managers may be fined up to EUR 7,500; after two consecutive years of non-compliance, the Public Prosecutor may order administrative strike-off (radiation) from the RCS

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual confirmation and update of the beneficial owner declaration (declaration des beneficiaires effectifs)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Registre du Commerce et des Societes via the Guichet Unique operated by the INPI; data is attached to the permanent RCS file
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within thirty days of any change in direct or indirect ownership or control of the SARL; France does not impose a separate annual re-filing when the declared data remains unchanged, but the record must be verified as accurate when the annual accounts are deposited
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Unfiled or knowingly inaccurate declarations are punishable by a criminal fine of up to EUR 7,500 and imprisonment of up to six months; the registrar may also refuse subsequent filings and the company remains exposed to strike-off proceedings

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual corporate income tax return and financial annexes (declaration de resultat form 2065-SD and liasse fiscale)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Direction Generale des Finances Publiques (DGFiP), Corporate Tax Unit, via the professional online filing portal
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within three months of the fiscal year close; for a calendar-year SARL, no later than the second working day following 1 May (normally 2 or 3 May); the balance of corporate income tax is payable by the same deadline in a single payment
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing or omission penalty of 10% of the net corporate tax payable, increased to 40% where payment is not made within thirty days of a formal notice; late-payment interest accrues at 0.2% per month; willful failure or fraudulent filing may trigger up to 80% penalties and criminal sanctions

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: A statutory auditor (commissaire aux comptes) must be appointed for the SARL if at least two of the following three thresholds are exceeded on the closing date of each of two consecutive financial years: total balance sheet exceeding EUR 4,000,000; net turnover exceeding EUR 8,000,000; average permanent workforce exceeding 50 employees. Audit is also mandatory where the SARL controls one or more subsidiaries that, in aggregate, exceed the same criteria or where member representing at least 10% of share capital applies to the court.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: French statutory accounting framework (Plan Comptable General), incorporating ANC regulations and Code de commerce articles L.123-12 to L.123-22; individual accounts of a non-listed SARL must be prepared under French GAAP, and IFRS is not permitted for the statutory individual accounts.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: France does not provide a standalone annual UBO confirmation return. The declaration of beneficial owners is submitted at incorporation and must be updated within thirty days of any event changing the ownership or control of the SARL, including share transfers and changes among corporate shareholders. At the time of depositing annual accounts, the manager must verify that the beneficial owner file on the RCS remains current and correct; any transfer of shares that occurred before the annual filing must first be reflected in the updated UBO declaration. The UBO statement always identifies the natural persons who ultimately own or control the SARL, irrespective of whether payouts are routed through Apple App Store or Google Play intermediaries.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Shareholders' decisions book (registre des decisions d'associes), holding minutes of all general meetings and written consultations
Register of share movements, transfers and pledges over parts sociales (registre des mouvements de parts), evidencing lawful transfers among MMORPG project shareholders
Register of manager appointments and signatures (retained with RCS K-bis extract and manager identity documents)
Beneficial owner declaration file and supporting shareholding diagram, updated within thirty days after any transfer or control event
Minutes book and attendance sheets of general meetings, retained for at least seven years

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: USD 300 - USD 900 per year for a commercial registered office and professional domiciliation service in Paris or Ile-de-France
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: USD 6,000 - USD 18,000 per year for a mid-tier certified audit firm where the SARL exceeds the statutory audit thresholds, excluding group consolidation and ancillary tax work
